scripts.publish:ios: npm run build:ios && npm run submit:ios
scripts.publish:android: npm run build:android && npm run submit:android
scripts.web:deploy: npm run web:build && echo 'Upload the dist/ folder to Vercel or Cloudflare Pages'
scripts.test:rules: PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/bin:$PATH firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test-ports.json --only firestore,storage --project demo-a2 "node scripts/test-pickup-transition.cjs && node scripts/test-pickup-release.cjs && node scripts/test-delivery-flow.cjs && node scripts/test-a2-rules.cjs && node scripts/test-c1-complete.cjs && node scripts/test-idgate.cjs && node scripts/test-c1-client.cjs && node --test tests/rules/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:functions: PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/bin:$PATH firebase emulators:exec --config firebase.test-ports.json --only auth,functions,firestore --project demo-c1 "FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:5301 node scripts/test-c1-callable.cjs"
scripts.test:emulators: npm run test:rules && npm run test:functions
scripts.web:emulators:alt: EXPO_PUBLIC_USE_FIREBASE_EMULATORS=1 EXPO_PUBLIC_EMULATOR_PROJECT_ID=demo-bn-rescue EXPO_PUBLIC_AUTH_EMULATOR_PORT=9289 EXPO_PUBLIC_FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_PORT=8280 EXPO_PUBLIC_STORAGE_EMULATOR_PORT=9399 EXPO_PUBLIC_FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR_PORT=5201 expo start --web --port 8081
